questions.question: Manohar cycles X km towards west and then turns right and cycles Y km to reach his office. Now, the shortest distance between the starting point and his office is 13 km. What can be the value of X and Y, respectively, (in km)?
questions.questionHtml:
Manohar cycles X km towards west and then turns right and cycles Y km to reach his office. Now, the shortest distance between the starting point and his office is 13 km.

What can be the value of X and Y, respectively, (in km)?
questions.solution:
Given: Manohar cycles X km towards west and then turns right and cycles Y km to reach his office.

Now, the shortest distance between the starting point and his office is 13 km.

According to the given instructions, it forms a right angle triangle:

In a right angled triangle

(Base)2 + (Perpendicular)2  = (Hypotenuse)2

X2  + Y2 = (13)2

(12)2 + (5)2 = (13)2

144 + 25 = 169

169 = 169.

So, the possible values of X and Y is 12 and 5.

Hence, the correct answer is 'Option 1'.

questions.question: If South-East becomes North, North-East becomes West and so on, what will South-West become?
questions.questionHtml: If South-East becomes North, North-East becomes West and so on, what will South-West become?
questions.solution:
Let the angle between South – East and North – East be 90⁰.

Rotation of South – East by 135⁰ (90⁰ + 45⁰) gives North.

Rotation of North – East by 135⁰ gives West.

Similarly, rotation of South – West by 135⁰ gives East.

Hence, the correct answer is ‘East’.
